reviewer: Arena agent visual inspection of generated PNGs

observations: The lake is not visibly legible in the overview, despite its center projecting inside the camera frame; dense dark canopy blocks the right half of the image.
The clearing and tree line have excessive contrast; large areas of foliage collapse to near-black, and foreground vegetation still competes with the robot.
The smoother shoreline mesh cannot be visually verified because the water surface is occluded in these frames.
The robot silhouette is small and underlit; its lower body and feet blend into dark foliage and ground clutter.
The three overviews show changing poses, but do not make the foot plants and natural walking gait clear enough for acceptance. The numeric IK audit is not a substitute.
